subject: Request: Marketplace credit extension for Siemens pilot
messages:
From: Alex Mueller <alex.mueller@siemens.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@siemens.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Marketplace credit request for regional pilot

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're excited to move our pilot (Siemens DI — regional asset digitization) onto the Azure Marketplace entry next month. Before we onboard, procurement asked whether Redwood can extend the promotional credits you provided at the accelerator stage so we can run the expanded ingestion/embedding tests for an extra 6 weeks.

Current ask: +$30k in marketplace credits (Azure SKU) scoped to the pilot workspace and valid through 2027-04-15. Siemens legal needs a note confirming credits are partner-sourced and limited to the marketplace listing (not general enterprise credits).

I've attached a one-page summary and rough usage estimates. Can you let me know what approvals we need? We have a firm go/no-go decision scheduled 2027-03-15.

Appreciate it — Alex

---
Alex Mueller
Program Lead, Digitalization
Siemens Digital Industries
T: +49 160 555 0123
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Alex Mueller <alex.mueller@siemens.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, camila.reyes@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 10:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Marketplace credit request for regional pilot

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the attachment. Short answer: yes, we can support a partner-sourced marketplace credit extension but need approvals from Partner Ops and SellOps for the SKU allocation and duration.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll loop in Ben (Partner Sales) and Camila (Marketplace Partnerships) to confirm the credit mechanics and whether this can be surfaced as an Azure Marketplace voucher tied to the listing.
- We will need Siemens to sign a short acceptance that the credit is for the marketplace pilot workspace and won't be convertible to cash or applied to other Redwood invoices. That mirrors what you've proposed.
- Please confirm the exact Azure offer ID and the tenant where the SKU will be consumed.

Ben/Camila — can you review the attached usage estimate and advise the feasible credit amount and timeframe? We should also consider whether a staged release (15k now + 15k on milestone) helps reduce financial exposure.

I'll coordinate approvals on my side once we have the SKU + tenant details.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, camila.reyes@redwood.com
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 08:30:00 +0100
Subject: RE: Marketplace credit request for regional pilot

Laura, Camila — reviewed the estimate. If Siemens consumes roughly 2.5M tokens/week (embeddings + generation mix) the $30k ask is in the right ballpark for a 6-week window, assuming usual token rates and no heavy spike. Two operational items:

1) Marketplace voucher workflow: Camila, can the credit be issued as a marketplace commitment (Azure offer) or do we need a manual voucher code? If it's an Azure offer, legal ops will need the partner contract amendment.
2) Risk control: Markus, Partner Ops — can we gate the second half of the credits on milestone acceptance (open API throughput test + 2 sample workloads completed)? That would be my recommendation.

If Partner Ops signs off on the staged release, I'm fine fast-tracking SellOps approval (we can auto-apply via account metadata).

Ben
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: camila.reyes@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 14:02:00 +0100
Subject: RE: Marketplace credit request for regional pilot

Quick update — I checked with Azure marketplace team: we can issue a "publisher credit" tied to the offer ID but it requires a short amendment to the current marketplace listing and an internal voucher mapping. That process typically takes 5 business days. The voucher can be restricted to a tenant and expiration date.

Recommendation: approve 15,000 EUR equivalent now and hold remaining 15,000 EUR pending milestone sign-off. We'll need a signed partner acknowledgment (I can draft) and a copy of Siemens' tenant ID.

I'll prepare the mapping doc and a draft partner ack. Markus, can you confirm the Go/No-Go milestone criteria you'd require for releasing tranche 2?

Thanks — Camila
Marketplace Partnerships
From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, camila.reyes@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2027 17:45:00 +0100
Subject: RE: Marketplace credit request for regional pilot

All — Partner Ops sign-off: staging is acceptable. Proposed milestone conditions to release tranche 2 (by 2027-03-01):
1) Successful onboarding: Siemens must complete the ingestion pipeline and show end-to-end inference on a 50k-record sample dataset.
2) Performance check: 95th percentile tail latency within agreed SLO (<= 700ms for the sample workload).
3) Usage sanity: weekly token burn within +/- 30% of the provided estimate.

Legal/finance note: Camila to draft partner acknowledgment that credits are non-transferable and limited to the marketplace SKU. Once we have signed ack and tenant ID, I will authorize issuance of tranche 1 (15k EUR equivalent) immediately and schedule tranche 2 contingent on milestone evidence.

Markus Klein
Head, Partner Operations
Redwood Inference
